name: WuHu Foresight Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: WuHu Foresight Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of automotive interior parts in China. The company offers air conditioning vent systems, cup holders, inner opening handles, storage boxes, interior door handles, and armrests; decorative strips and rings, painting, and wrapping parts; airducts and inject parts; and insert molding parts. It also provides functional components; eyeglasses cases; and ceiling handles. WuHu Foresight Technology Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Wuhu, China.
